title: Five Winters and One Short Scarf
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）　|　核心词汇：fan　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fan 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 my brother ① met a fan that no coach in the club would have thanked, and he said the meeting was the whole of the winter. The ② fan, meaning the supporter himself and not the player, ran five winters and stayed unthanked in the book; a fan, he said, is the only thing in a club that is judged by how long it is left unthanked.

Every ③ fan in that club had the same short scarf beside him, and the ④ fan at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the final and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fan, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to thank; my brother said the thanking is the part that fills five winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fan was the whole of the engine, meaning the blade and not the supporter. The ⑥ fan, meaning the blade and not any of that, is the only thing in an engine that everybody waits for and nobody thanks; fan, he said, is either somebody you meet or the only word that means both a supporter and a blade. He said the blade is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ fan had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short scarf. The ⑧ fan of the whole thing, my brother wrote in January, was one club and five winters of thanking; fan, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to thank. He said the thanking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fan I remember is the one thanked in the list, which closed in 1989 and is still described as the quietest in the club. A ⑩ fan, my mother said in 1991, is the only one that improves by being thanked; every fan, she said, is a blade that has agreed to look like a supporter. She said the blade was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 球迷；爱好者（指俱乐部里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 球迷（指那个人本身，与队员相对）
C. 固定搭配：meet a fan 见到一位球迷
D. n. 球迷（指留给决赛的那一位）
E. n. 球迷（抽象总称，指一家俱乐部的球迷之事）
F. n. 球迷（指名单上写到、被致谢的那一位）
G. n. 扇子；风扇（指一台发动机里人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西）
H. n. 风扇（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西）

items.q: met a fan that no coach in the club would have thanked
The fan, meaning the supporter himself and not the player
the fan at the far side
the fan was the whole of the engine
the fan had become a line in a list
The fan of the whole thing
A fan, my mother said in 1991

answers.why: meet a fan 意为“见到一位球迷”，1982 年哥哥见了一位俱乐部里没有一位教练肯致谢的球迷。
fan 意为“球迷”，指那个人本身而不是队员，他经过了五个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
fan 意为“球迷”，指俱乐部里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一条短短的围巾。
fan 意为“球迷”，指留给决赛的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fan 意为“扇子、风扇”，指一台发动机里人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西，叔叔说这台风扇就是那台发动机的全部。
fan 意为“风扇”，指人人都等却无人致谢的那样东西而不是那一位球迷，是发动机里人人都等、却无人致谢的东西。
fan 意为“球迷”，指名单上写到、被致谢的那一位，到 1987 年这一位成了名单里的一行。
fan 意为“球迷”，哥哥一月写道，整件事的球迷之事是一家俱乐部和五个冬天的致谢。
fan 意为“球迷”，我记得的是名单上致谢的那一位，1989 年结束了，至今仍被说成俱乐部里最安静的一位。
fan 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，一位球迷是唯一会因为被好好致谢而变得更好的东西。
